title: SelfTestResult
description: Verdict the renderer reports through host.reportSelfTest when the host was launched with --self-test. The host writes it to disk and exits 0 or 1, which is what CI gates on.

succeeded.description: True only when every check passed.

checks.description: Individual assertions the renderer performed, in the order it performed them.

name.description: Stable identifier of the check, for example rpc_round_trip or notification_stream.

detail.description: Diagnostic detail, present when the check failed.
